title: HTML
subtitle: Web Page ka Structure
what_is_it: HTML ek markup language hai jo website ka basic structure aur content define karti hai.
benefits: Website ke pages, forms aur content khud bana paoge.
Frontend Web Development ki foundation isi se shuru hoti hai.
Portfolio website, blog, landing page aur simple web pages bana sakte ho.
miss_if_not_learn: Agar HTML nahi seekhoge to website ka structure samajhna mushkil hoga. CSS aur JavaScript bhi effectively use nahi kar paoge.

title: CSS
subtitle: Website ko Beautiful Banane ki Language
what_is_it: CSS website ki styling, colors, layout aur responsive design control karti hai.
benefits: Professional-looking aur mobile-friendly websites bana paoge.
UI/UX aur Frontend Developer roles ke liye important skill hai.
Animations, cards, buttons aur modern layouts design kar sakte ho.
miss_if_not_learn: Agar CSS nahi seekhoge to website sirf plain text jaisi lagegi. Users ko achha experience dena mushkil ho jayega.

title: JavaScript
subtitle: Website ko Interactive Banane ki Language
what_is_it: JavaScript website me logic aur interactivity add karti hai.
benefits: Buttons, forms, login systems aur dynamic features bana sakte ho.
Frontend aur Full Stack Developer jobs ke liye core skill hai.
Games, web apps, dashboards aur API-based projects bana sakte ho.
miss_if_not_learn: Agar JavaScript nahi seekhoge to websites static rahengi. Modern web apps banana mushkil ho jayega.

title: Python
subtitle: Simple aur Powerful Programming Language
what_is_it: Python ek beginner-friendly programming language hai jo automation, AI, backend aur data analysis me use hoti hai.
benefits: Automation scripts likhkar repetitive kaam aasaan bana sakte ho.
AI, Machine Learning, Data Science aur Backend Development me career bana sakte ho.
Bots, APIs, desktop tools aur web applications develop kar sakte ho.
miss_if_not_learn: Agar Python nahi seekhoge to AI aur automation jaise popular fields me entry thodi mushkil ho sakti hai.

title: Real Projects
subtitle: HTML + CSS + JS ko Milaakar Banao
what_is_it: Ye course tumhe HTML, CSS aur JavaScript teeno ko combine karke real websites aur mini-apps banana sikhata hai.
benefits: Profile card, todo list, calculator, quiz app jaise 20 real projects banaoge.
Teeno languages ka combined use samajh aaega, jo asli development hai.
Portfolio ke liye ready-made projects mil jayenge.
miss_if_not_learn: Bina practice ke sirf theory se real app banana mushkil lagega. Ye course wahi gap bharta hai.
locked_hint: Pehle HTML, CSS aur JS complete karo
